    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    car_patches = image_patch.find("black car")
    parking_area_patches = image_patch.find("parking area")
    buildings_patches = image_patch.find("buildings")

    if not car_patches or not parking_area_patches or not buildings_patches:
        return []

    # Find cars that are in front of buildings
    cars_in_front_of_buildings = [car for car in car_patches if is_in_front_of(car, buildings_patches[0])]

    # Filter cars that are along the side of the parking area
    cars_along_parking_area = []
    for car in cars_in_front_of_buildings:
        for area in parking_area_patches:
            if area.left <= car.left <= area.right or area.lower <= car.lower <= area.upper:
                cars_along_parking_area.append(car)
                break
